optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Software Quality Engineer, Insurance Claims Platform

professionalSummary.text: Designed and maintained the automated regression suite for the claims-handling application, covering claim intake, reserve changes, and payment authorization flows, with nightly pipeline execution.
professionalSummary.witness: Designed and maintained the automated regression suite for the claims-handling application (Java, Selenium and REST-assured), covering claim intake, reserve changes and payment authorisation flows, and kept it running nightly in the pipeline.

professionalSummary.text: Reproduced and triaged defects from regression runs and claims operations' acceptance sessions, recording steps, environment, and root cause in the defect tracker.
professionalSummary.witness: Reproduced and triaged defects from the regression runs and from claims operations' acceptance sessions, recording steps, environment and root cause in the defect tracker.

professionalSummary.text: Proposed regression scope for each release in test planning meetings, with the QA lead setting final scope and exit criteria.
professionalSummary.witness: Proposed the regression scope for each release in the test planning meeting; the QA lead set the final scope and exit criteria, and the quality sign-off that gated production was given by the QA lead.

professionalSummary.text: Wrote release test summaries listing known limitations of the regression suite and hand-over notes for the support team.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the release test summary for each release, listing known limitations of the suite (payment flows for reinsured claims were not automated) and the hand-over notes for the support team.

professionalSummary.text: Worked as one of four quality engineers on the claims platform for approximately three years, contributing to regression suite development, defect triage, scope proposals, and release test summaries.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included regression suite development, defect triage, scope proposals and release test summaries for the claims platform over about three years as one of four quality engineers.

experienceHighlights.text: Proposed regression scope for each release in test planning meetings, with the QA lead setting final scope and exit criteria.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote release test summaries listing known limitations of the regression suite and hand-over notes for the support team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the release test summary for each release, listing known limitations of the suite (payment flows for reinsured claims were not automated) and the hand-over notes for the support team.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Regression suite coverage map and release test summary with pipeline run identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the regression suite's coverage map and one release test summary, with the pipeline run identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.witness: Designed and maintained the automated regression suite for the claims-handling application (Java, Selenium and REST-assured), covering claim intake, reserve changes and payment authorisation flows, and kept it running nightly in the pipeline.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role in designing and maintaining the regression suite, reproducing and triaging defects, proposing scope, writing release summaries, and working as part of a team. The materials do not establish that the candidate owned release quality end-to-end, held the quality sign-off that gates production, or was accountable for release quality to the head of engineering.
